description: Watch one tab in the background until a progress condition completes — an upload reaching 100%, a build log announcing success, a spinner disappearing. Returns a monitorId immediately; the extension pins the tab, keeps watching with no further tool calls even while the user works elsewhere, and notifies them on completion. Call page.findProgress first to pick a real signal. Check on it with page.monitorStatus, block for it with page.awaitMonitor, end it with page.stopMonitor.

label.description: Short name shown in the side panel and the completion notification, e.g. "YouTube upload"

tabId.description: Tab to watch, from page.openTab or page.switchTab. Defaults to the active tab.

timeoutMs.description: Give up and report a timeout after this long

until.description: The condition that completes the watch

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression — required for text-matches and title-matches, e.g. "upload complete|processing finished"

target.description: Element to watch — required for element-appears, element-vanishes and progress-reaches; optional scope for text-matches

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

threshold.description: For progress-reaches: the watch completes when progress reaches this percent

name: page_startMonitor
